runtime_dependency_reason: Both repositories currently publish the same distribution and import namespace, and the canonical upstream is private while this downstream is public.
sync_rules: Do not merge or cherry-pick histories between the repositories.
Port shared source changes through reviewed commits with provenance.
Keep the tracked Python package tree byte-identical to the accepted upstream revision.
Keep company-only capabilities isolated until separately accepted upstream.
Do not make public installation depend on private Git credentials.
